newsitem.title: USA: Concordia Paper signs $47.2 million loan.
newsitem.headline: Concordia Paper signs $47.2 million loan.

text.p: Concordia Paper Holdings Ltd of Hong Kong said on Tuesday that it had completed a long-term debt restructuring plan following the signing of a US$47.2 million, five-year loan facility for its wholly owned subsidiary Concordia Paper Ltd.
"The proceeds of the new syndicated loan will be used to refinance all Concordia's existing long-term bank debt obligations and reduce its short-term bank debt," the company said in a statement.
The company said the plan would also impove its working capital position.
The banks participating in the syndiated loan are Bank of Tokyo Mitsubishi Ltd, Standard Chartered Bank, Bank of Tokyo Lease and Dai-Ichi Kango Bank.
Concordia, located in the New Territories of Hong Kong, is a manufacturer of boxboard.
